Blueberry Sorbet
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:58am

Ingredients




36 ounces lemon-lime soda
1 cup fresh blueberries

Preparation

1 Pour soda in a 2-inch deep flat pan. Place, uncovered, in the freezer. Freeze until solid Remove from freezer ans scrape frozen soda with the dull edge of a knife into a medium-sized bowl. Add blueberries to the slush. Cover the mixture and return to the freezer. Freeze until firm. 2 Start to Finish Time:"3:00"
